Episode 4
Logline: When Victoria is cornered by the sudden resurrection of Leo, her desperate final confession triggers a deadly betrayal that traps Julian with a brother he no longer recognizes.

SCENE 1 - INT. CEO OFFICE - NIGHT

CAMERA: [00:00.00 - 00:02.50] Wide shot of the office door swinging open, light silhouetting a tall figure.
ACTION: [00:02.60 - 00:05.00] Victoria stumbles back in horror, clutching her bruised arm.
SOUND FX: [00:05.10 - 00:06.50] Low, menacing cinematic bass drop.
CAMERA: [00:06.60 - 00:09.50] Close-up of Leo entering, looking identical to Julian but wearing a dark trench coat with a cold smirk.
VICTORIA (Terrified): [00:09.60 - 00:12.00] "No... it's impossible. I saw your body in the morgue!"
LEO (Amused): [00:12.10 - 00:14.50] "You saw a paid-off medical examiner's report, Victoria."
CAMERA: [00:14.60 - 00:17.50] Medium shot panning from Leo to Julian, who stands up from the desk, straightening his cuffs.
JULIAN (Cold): [00:17.60 - 00:20.00] "We needed you to think Leo was dead so you'd finally play your hand."
ACTION: [00:20.10 - 00:23.00] Victoria frantically backs toward the desk, her eyes darting around the room in absolute panic.
VICTORIA (Desperate): [00:23.10 - 00:25.50] "You think you've won? The board will never accept an impostor and a ghost!"
CAMERA: [00:25.60 - 00:28.50] Extreme close-up of Julian sliding a lit tablet across the mahogany desk.
SOUND FX: [00:28.60 - 00:30.00] Electronic swoosh as the tablet screen lights up.
JULIAN (Mocking): [00:30.10 - 00:32.50] "The board is watching us right now on a live stream, Victoria."
CAMERA: [00:32.60 - 00:35.50] Rapid zoom-in on Victoria's face as she stares at the tablet showing active video feeds of board members.
LEO (Stern): [00:35.60 - 00:38.00] "They just heard you confess to poisoning my car's brakes."
VICTORIA (Hysterical): [00:38.10 - 00:40.50] "You can't prove anything! I'll ruin you both!"
ACTION: [00:40.60 - 00:43.50] Victoria lunges at Julian to slap him, but Leo grabs her wrist mid-air in slow-motion.
SOUND FX: [00:43.60 - 00:45.00] Sharp, echoing slap of skin meeting skin as he grips her.
LEO (Whispering): [00:45.10 - 00:47.50] "Don't touch my brother. You're finished."
ACTION: [00:47.60 - 00:50.50] The doors burst open, and two police officers rush in, immediately handcuffing Victoria.
SOUND FX: [00:50.60 - 00:52.00] Police radio static and heavy footsteps.
VICTORIA (Screaming): [00:52.10 - 00:54.50] "Get your hands off me! Do you know who I am?!"
CAMERA: [00:54.60 - 00:57.50] Close-up of Julian watching her with cold satisfaction as she is forced toward the door.
ACTION: [00:57.60 - 01:00.50] As the officers drag Victoria past Leo, she suddenly stops, her expression shifting to a sinister, knowing grin.
VICTORIA (Venomous): [01:00.60 - 01:03.50] "You think you're safe, Julian? Ask your 'beloved brother' who paid me to kill you."
SOUND FX: [01:03.60 - 01:05.00] Sudden, high-pitched ringing sound, building massive tension.
CAMERA: [01:05.10 - 01:08.00] Quick pan to Julian's face as his smile completely vanishes, replaced by sudden doubt.
JULIAN (Shaken): [01:08.10 - 01:10.50] "What... what did you just say?"
CAMERA: [01:10.60 - 01:13.50] Medium close-up on Leo, whose expression slowly hardens into a terrifying, silent stare.
ACTION: [01:13.60 - 01:16.50] Leo pulls a syringe out of his trench coat pocket, hiding it behind his back, looking directly at Julian.
VICTORIA (Laughing): [01:16.60 - 01:19.50] "He wanted the empire all to himself, fool. And now, you're trapped alone with him."
ACTION: [01:19.60 - 01:22.50] The police drag the laughing Victoria out, leaving Julian and Leo alone as the door slams shut.
SOUND FX: [01:22.60 - 01:24.00] Heavy wooden door slamming shut, locking with an electronic click.
CAMERA: [01:24.10 - 01:27.00] Close-up of Julian taking a step back as Leo slowly steps forward, his eyes completely devoid of warmth.
LEO (Threatening): [01:27.10 - 01:29.50] "She's right, brother. There's only room for one CEO."
CAMERA: [01:29.60 - 01:32.50] Extreme close-up of Julian's terrified eyes as Leo's shadow falls over his face.
SOUND FX: [01:32.60 - 01:35.00] Heartbeat thumping loudly, then a sudden metallic click of a syringe needle cap popping off.
